questions.solution:

(1) 4 - 27

(2) 6 - 125

(3) 7 - 216

(4) 5 - 63
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number - 1)³ = Second number

 
• 4 - 27 → (4 - 1)³ = 3³ = 27
 
• 6 - 125 → (6 - 1)3 = 53 = 125
 
• 7 - 216 → (7 - 1)3 = 63 = 216
 
• **5 - 63 → (5 - 1)3 = 43 = 64 ≠ 63**

Hence, '**4**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following Provisions of the Indian Constitution is taken from the US Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**Post of vice president.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The provision of the post of **vice president** in the Indian Constitution is taken from the **US Constitution.**
 
• The vice president of India is the** second-highest constitutional office** in the country and is elected indirectly by an **Electoral College** consisting of members of both houses of Parliament.
 
• The **US Constitution** also provides for a vice president who serves as the second-in-command to the **President **and is elected through a similar Electoral College system.
 
• The Indian Constitution also draws inspiration from other constitutions, such as the **British Constitution, the Irish Constitution, and the Australian Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental duties** are a unique provision of the Indian Constitution that was added through the **42ⁿd Amendment in 1976.**
 
• It imposes certain obligations on citizens to uphold the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India, and to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood among all people.
 
• **The procedure for amendment of constitution **is also a unique provision of the Indian Constitution that outlines the steps required to amend the Constitution.
 
• It requires a special majority of both houses of Parliament, as well as** ratification **by at least half of the state legislatures.
 
• **Bicameralism **refers to the division of the legislature into two houses - the **Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha** in the case of India.
 
• This is not a provision that is taken from the **US Constitution**, as the US has a unicameral legislature consisting of a single House of Representatives and a Senate.

questions.question: What is the nominal GDP if the real GDP is 500 and the price index is 150?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**750.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this question, the** real GDP** is given as** 500 **and the **price index** is given as **150.**
 
• To calculate the nominal GDP, we need to multiply the real GDP by the price index and **divide by 100.**
 
• Hence, the nominal GDP would be **(500 x 150) / 100 = 750.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nominal GDP** refers to the monetary value of all **final goods and services** produced within a country's borders during a specified period.
 
• **Real GDP** is an inflation-adjusted measure of a country's** economic output.**
 
• **GDP** calculates the monetary worth of **finished goods and services**—those purchased by the end user—that are generated in a nation during a specific time period.

questions.question: What are the events in powerlifting?

options.text: Squats, bench press and dead lift
Squats, lat pull down and curl
Curls, over arm lift and dead lift

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Squats, bench press and dead lift.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Powerlifting **is a **strength sport** that involves lifting as much weight as possible in three different exercises: **squats, bench press, and deadlift.**
 
• These exercises are collectively known as the **"big three"** in powerlifting.
 
• Squats involve lifting a** barbell on your shoulders** and **lowering your body** until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
 
• This exercise primarily targets your **quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings.**
 
• Bench press involves lying on a **bench and lifting **a barbell off a rack, lowering it to your chest, and then pressing it back up.
 
• This exercise primarily targets your **chest, shoulders, and triceps.**
 
• Deadlift involves lifting a** barbell off the ground **and standing up with it.
 
• This exercise primarily targets your **lower back, glutes, and hamstrings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sport known as** "odd lifts"** gave rise to powerlifting.
 
• It was based on the** same three-attempt pattern **but featured a wider range of events, similar to strongman competition.
 
• **Odd lifts** eventually became the **current three standard lifts.**
 
• Lifts may be performed **equipped or unequipped** during competition.
 
• In this context, "equipment" is a supporting **bench shirt, briefs, or a squat/deadlift suit.**

• The purchase of machinery in** Railways** is a **Capital Expenditure** as it involves the acquisition of a **fixed asset** that will be used over a period of time to generate revenue for the **Railways.**
